messages:
jin: Heads up — canary showed a skew: small tenants saw higher soft-evict rates after the prefix-sharing change. Question: should we move eviction decision to a shard-local coordinator (delegation) or keep it per-prefix (local)?

maya: saw that. numbers?

jin: 20% increase in 99th eviction cycles for <10GB tenants. metric: `evict_cycles_per_minute` spike. Logs: `evict: reason=spillover tenant=ten123 slab=3`

oleg: delegation idea: a shard-level arbitrator knows occupancy and can preemptively relocate prefixes. Pro: global view. Con: cross-node churn.

taylor: local decision reduces cross-tenant cost but leads to oscillation when tenants hot-spot. Need hysteresis.

sam: @maya can you attach the experiment dashboard? Also we should consider a small grace window + token bucket.

maya: dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/evict-canary -> looks like post-change bump aligns with batch size tuning

jin: proposal sketch: keep local fast-path for low-latency evict, but consult shard-arbiter every N seconds for heavy eviction events. If arbiter suggests migrate -> schedule background handoff.

oleg: sounds like hybrid. Need invariants: never migrate while prefix has in-flight leases > 0. Add check `if active_leases > 0 then defer`

taylor: and tie to prefetched KV residency metadata version — avoid split-brain. Maybe increment `residency_epoch` at handoff.

sam: ops note: implement metrics: `evict_decision_source{local|shard}` and `handoff_deferred_reason`

infra-bot: Deploy note: canary flag `prefetch.eviction.hybrid=true` will be toggled in next deploy. CI: `make canary`

jin: Plan: 1) add metrics & deferral reasons (2d) 2) implement arbiter consult (3d) 3) canary with 10% nodes (1w) 4) rollback if 99p evict_cycles > baseline+10% (auto).

maya: ack. I'll own dashboard + alert.

oleg: I'll sketch proto for arbiter API; simple RPC: `QueryEvictHints(shard_id, capacity)` -> returns {action: migrate|no-op, target: node}

taylor: We should add a simulation run in the repo before canary. Quick script idea: `scripts/sim_eviction.py --tenants 1000 --hotspots 5`

jin: thanks. let's sync tomorrow 10am in eng-runtime. tagging @sam for SLO impacts.

sam: on it. ping me once dashboard ready. :thumbsup:
